第一千六百七十章妖族传承
混沌钟爆发的空间乱流，连萧叶自己都差点没有跑出去。
伴随着乱流的遁走，他自己都不知道来到了什么地方。
空间撕裂，重重地砸在了地面上，掀起一阵尘土。
“咳咳......”
“谁啊，有没有公德心了。”
还未起身就听到了两个谩骂声，不过听着有些熟悉。抬起头，萧叶看着眼前二人，虽说是人，但外形上更加的贴合妖兽。慢慢的，从那熟悉的灵力气息，萧叶倒也认出来了二人乃是蓝羽和泰岳。
“你们两个怎么在这里？”
“老大！怎么是你啊，你这...怎么感觉有那么一点狼狈啊。”蓝羽也没有想到在这里碰到了萧叶，身旁的泰岳也是没有想到，有些巧合了。
萧叶看了看两个，感知了一些气息，瞬间有些摸不着头脑。
“你...这些年都跑去睡觉了，怎么还是七阶，你身旁的这个石头都已经八阶了。”萧叶看着蓝羽，这只大鸟都过去这么多年了，还是七阶巅峰的修为，几乎没有什么长进。
还身负毕方的血脉呢，就这。
自己小儿子来了，说不定都能够暴打呢。
“七阶的修为都敢来这里，你是真的不怕被拔毛熬汤，你也不害怕被当成一个灶台。”萧叶看了看蓝羽和泰岳，后者却是达到了八阶，但也仅仅只是八阶。
在这里，陨落的风险也是高达八九成的。
“这不是富贵险中求吗，老大你以前不也经常这样吗。”蓝羽说道。
“前提是因为我有那个实力，你呢，你有什么，一身毛？”萧叶看了看两个家伙，一个七阶，一个也不过突破八阶不久，来到这里这不是找死还是做什么。
“我们可能是找死了，但为什么来到这里，应该是我们问你才对吧。这里可是妖族的聚集地，你是人族来这里做什么，难不成要重新找坐骑？”蓝羽觉得自己的地位受到了威胁，虽然他也没有做到一个坐骑该有的责任。
“我是逃跑的时候无意间来到这里的，我又不知道这里是什么地方，睁开眼睛就看到你们两个了。”萧叶说道，差点玩脱了。
“呦，还有人能让你狼狈的逃跑，刚才谁还说自己有实力的。”蓝羽嘲讽了两句，泰岳无奈的捂脸，这家伙是真的不怕死，自己也悄默默地挪移两步。

砰！
砰！
砰！！
蓝羽趴在地上，一脸的生无可恋，怀疑鸟生。
“坐骑就要有坐骑的样子，敢和主人顶嘴，我看你是不想活了。毕方的血脉，火灾的化生，我倒要看看你会不会被烤熟！”萧叶真想拔毛剥皮，将这鸟烤来吃了。
“你来说。”
“那个萧叶，这里有着冲天的妖气，你自己也应该感受到了，对于其余的种族都是非常不友好的。”泰岳说道：“这里曾经是上古妖庭，改造出来的栖息地，有着妖族的传承。”
“来到这里，有实力的妖族都会来这里碰碰运气。当然，更多在这里的还是本土的妖族强者，几乎占据了这里七成以上的资源，剩下的三成是无法完全占据的。”
“别说是人族了，就算是同为妖族的我们，也被本土妖族是作为外来者，都是充满了仇视的。”
萧叶心中暗想，这是什么，谁说除去人族都很团结的，这不就是矛盾点吗。
“妖族的传承，还是上古妖庭......我身上有着妖庭的东西，会不会得到认可获得传承？”萧叶原地自言自语的说道：“魔族，冥族，巫族的都有了，妖族还真的没有，要不要试试呢？”
泰岳作为一块石头，化成人形了面部也是没有表情，有些僵硬的。
但是听到萧叶的话，还有那一副自己要不要的表情，他自己也有些绷不住了。
悄悄这说的是人话吗，还有，你是真的贪啊，都这么多种族的传承了，还要过来和我们这些小妖抢，真的不当人了呗。

Chapter 1,670 The inheritance of the demon clan
The spatial turbulence erupted from the Chaos Clock made even Xiao Ye himself almost run out.
As he escaped from the turbulent current, he didn't even know where he had arrived.
The space was torn apart and it hit the ground hard, kicking up a cloud of dust.
"Ahem..."
"Who has a sense of public morality?"
Before he could get up, he heard two curses, but they sounded familiar. Raising his head, Xiao Ye looked at the two people in front of him. Although they were humans, their appearance more closely resembled that of a monster. Slowly, Xiao Ye recognized the two people as Lan Yu and Tai Yue from the familiar spiritual energy.
"Why are you two here?"
"Boss! Why is it you? Why do you... feel so embarrassed?" Lan Yu didn't expect to meet Xiao Ye here, and Tai Yue beside him didn't expect it either. It was a coincidence.
Xiao Ye looked at the two of them, sensed some auras, and was confused for a moment.
"You... have been running away to sleep all these years. Why are you still at the seventh level? The stone next to you is already at the eighth level." Xiao Ye looked at Lan Yu. After so many years, this big bird is still at the peak of the seventh level, with almost no progress.
He still carries Bi Fang's bloodline, that's all.
When my youngest son comes, he might be able to beat him violently.
"You dare to come here with a seventh-level cultivation. You are really not afraid of being plucked to make soup, and you are not afraid of being used as a stove." Xiao Ye looked at Lan Yu and Tai Yue. The latter had reached the eighth level, but it was only the eighth level.
Here, the risk of falling is also as high as 80% to 90%.
"Isn't this how to gain wealth through danger? Boss, haven't you often done this before?" Lan Yu said.
"The premise is that I have that strength. What about you, what do you have, hair all over your body?" Xiao Ye looked at the two guys, one was at level 7, and the other was only at level 8. They came here to seek death or something.
"We may be looking for death, but why are we here? We should ask you, right? This is the gathering place of the demon clan. What are you doing here from the human clan? Do you need to find a new mount?" Lan Yu felt that his status was threatened, although he did not fulfill the responsibilities of a mount.
"I came here accidentally when I was running away. I didn't know where this place was. When I opened my eyes, I saw you two." Xiao Ye said, almost losing his mind.
"Hey, there is someone who can make you run away in embarrassment. Who said he had strength just now?" Lan Yu mocked a few words, and Taiyue covered his face helplessly. This guy is really not afraid of death, and he quietly moved two steps away.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang! !
Lan Yu was lying on the ground with a look of despair on his face, doubting Niao Sheng.
"The mount must behave like a mount. If you dare to talk back to the owner, I think you don't want to live. With Bi Fang's bloodline and the transformation of fire, I want to see if you will be roasted!" Xiao Ye really wanted to pluck out the feathers, peel the skin, and roast the bird to eat.
"You tell me."
"That Xiao Ye, there is a soaring demonic energy here. You should have felt it yourself. It is very unfriendly to other races." Taiyue said: "This used to be the ancient demon court. The transformed habitat has the inheritance of the demon clan."
"When you come here, all the powerful demon clans will come here to try their luck. Of course, more of them are local demon clan strongmen, who occupy almost more than 70% of the resources here, and the remaining 30% cannot be fully occupied."
"Not to mention the human race, even we who are also the demon race are regarded as outsiders by the local demon race, and we are full of hatred."
Xiao Ye thought to himself, what is this? Who said everyone except the human race is united? Isn't this a contradiction?
"The inheritance of the demon clan is still the ancient demon court... I have something from the demon court in my body, will it be recognized and inherited?? "Xiao Ye said to himself on the spot: "The Demon Clan, the Nether Clan, and the Witch Clan are all there, but the Monster Clan really doesn't exist. Do you want to give it a try? "
As a stone, Taiyue's face is expressionless and somewhat stiff when it is transformed into a human form.
But after hearing Xiao Ye's words and the expression on his face that he didn't want it, he couldn't hold himself any longer.
Quietly, are you talking humanly? Also, you are really greedy. You have inherited the heritage of so many races, and you still want to come and rob us little monsters. You really don’t deserve to be human anymore.
